jobs.title: Compliance, Threat & Risk Assessment Manager
jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.
Compliance, Threat & Risk Assessment Manager
The Threat & Risk Assessment (TRA) team strengthens Coinbase's global compliance risk management framework by leading enterprise-wide and targeted risk assessments for compliance and financial crime compliance. As a Compliance, Threat & Risk Assessment Manager, you'll sit at the intersection of compliance, governance, data, and cross-functional execution, translating complex financial crimes and regulatory risks into clear, actionable insights for senior stakeholders across Coinbase legal entities globally.

What you'll do:
Manage enterprise-wide compliance risk assessments, including inherent risk identification, control evaluation, residual risk determination, and articulation of key findings and risk themes
Partner with MLROs, CCOs, and cross-functional stakeholders across Coinbase legal entities to deliver globally coordinated, locally relevant risk assessment outcomes
Produce risk assessment reports, executive summaries, and governance materials for senior leadership, risk forums, and regulatory audiences
Drive transaction monitoring and customer risk scoring coverage assessments and lead geographic risk rating updates ensuring ratings are current, risk-based, and operationally actionable
Develop a compliance threat assessment framework including governance, methodology, documentation standards, and ongoing maintenance
Pioneer AI-powered automation to scale assessment workflows, demonstrating high AI fluency while maintaining rigorous human judgment and oversight

Required Skills and Experience:
8+ years in compliance, financial crimes, or operational risk assessment within a regulated financial institution, fintech, or consulting firm
Demonstrated success independently leading large-scale risk assessments, influencing senior stakeholders, and driving cross-functional outcomes in ambiguous environments
Deep expertise in AML/CFT, sanctions, transaction monitoring, customer risk scoring, geographic risk assessment, and compliance risk management frameworks
Experience designing threat assessment frameworks, conducting TM/CRS coverage assessments, and leading geographic risk rating reviews across multi-entity or multi-jurisdictional compliance environments
Proven ability to produce executive-quality written communications, data analysis, and governance materials; proficiency in Excel, SQL, and AI platforms
Crypto-forward mindset with understanding of crypto products, services, and evolving ecosystem risks
Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.title: Senior Air Quality Specialist, Technical Leader
jobs.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

DOES THIS DESCRIBE YOU?

You’re a technically strong, solutions-oriented air quality expert with a passion for advancing environmental outcomes in California. You’re confident working independently, especially when it comes to complex emissions modeling and health risk assessments using tools like CalEEMod, AERMOD, and HARP—but you’re also energized by collaboration and mentoring others. You possess a deep understanding of CEQA/NEPA air quality assessments and excel when helping clients navigate regulatory frameworks or crafting effective project strategies. You bring rigor to your work, care about getting the details right, and enjoy sharing your expertise to help elevate your team. If you're ready to bring leadership, vision, and technical excellence to impactful projects, we’d love to meet you.

Ascent is seeking a full-time Senior Air Quality Specialist, Technical Leader to join our AGENTs (Air Quality/Greenhouse Gas/Energy/Noise/Transportation) team in any of our offices: Berkeley, Irvine/Orange County, Lake Tahoe, Sacramento, or San Diego. In a typical week in this role, you might:

Independently conduct emissions modeling, including Health Risk Assessments using CalEEMod, Excel, AERMOD, EMFAC, HARP, and OFFROAD.
Conduct, review, and provide QA/QC feedback on emissions modeling from software, including but not limited to Calero, Excel, AERMOD, EMFAC, HARP, and OFFROAD.
Lead and direct marketing and business development pursuits, including developing capture strategies.
Lead the preparation of proposals for midsized projects and assist with proposals for larger projects, providing technical input, contributing to proposal writing through scope and cost development, identifying opportunities, and engaging with proposal/interview teams.
Collaborate with the AGENTs team to provide mentorship, build technical capabilities and services, ensure high-quality deliverables, and develop internal training materials and modeling protocols.
Work collaboratively with Ascent’s Environmental Practice Group to ensure timely delivery of technical work meeting Ascent’s quality standards.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Requirements

Civil or environmental engineering, math, environmental science, atmospheric science, meteorology, geography, natural resources management, planning, or a related field.
A minimum of 8 years of direct professional experience conducting CEQA/NEPA air quality and GHG assessments.
Strong analytical, computer, spreadsheet, and writing skills are a must, and proficiency in emissions modeling software for development projects in California.
Successful candidates will have demonstrated experience running air quality emission models (EMFAC, CalEEMod, OFFROAD, MOVES) and dispersion models (CALINE-4, AERMOD, HARP) to evaluate project-related construction and operational emission and health impacts.
Candidate will have experience conducting emissions modeling QA/QC reviews, paying close attention to modeling methodologies and model accuracy.
Familiarity with state and federal air quality and climate change environmental policy and regulation, including CEQA, NEPA, and Clean Air Act, preferred.
Thorough understanding of the principles and practices, including meteorology, chemistry, and factors affecting air pollution distribution and effects.
Understanding of US EPA, California Air Resources Board, and local Air Quality Management District or Air Pollution Control District air quality regulatory programs and their relationship to the Federal and State Clean Air Acts.

Work environment

Typical office environment
Hybrid

Physical Demands

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
Must be able to lift 15 pounds at a time.

Travel

Limited travel may be required.

Work authorization/security clearance requirements:
Not eligible for sponsorship

Additional eligibility requirements:
N/A

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager - Remediation
jobs.description:
Are you driven to grow, lead, and make a meaningful impact? At Apex, we’re building more than a consulting and engineering firm—we’re creating a place where your career accelerates, your contributions matter, and your potential is fully realized. We believe your growth is our growth, which is why we invest in your development at every stage of your career. Here, you’ll work on projects that shape communities, protect the environment, and create lasting impact, all while being empowered with the autonomy and flexibility to do your best work.

Fueled by high-quality delivery, exceptional client retention, and strategic acquisitions, Apex Companies continues to rank among the fastest-growing firms in the AEC industry, recently recognized by the Zweig Group for our industry-leading growth. Our success is grounded in strong leadership, a collaborative culture, and a shared commitment to delivering exceptional outcomes.

As we continue to expand, we're looking for high-performing professionals who are ready to lead, collaborate, innovate, and create impact. At Apex, you help shape what's next. When we succeed together, we share in that success. All Apex positions are eligible for annual bonus opportunities, reinforcing our commitment to recognizing and rewarding meaningful contributions that drive our collective growth.

Apex is seeking a Senior Technical Project Manager to join our Thousand Oaks, CA office.

The Senior Technical Project Manager (PM) will lead and manage complex environmental investigation, remediation, and compliance projects involving contamination in soil, groundwater, sediment, soil vapor, surface water, and other environmental media. The role requires strong technical leadership, client management, project delivery, staff development, and business development capabilities. Experience with industrial, manufacturing, petroleum, government, and brownfield remediation programs is highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

Project and Program Management

Manage large-scale environmental investigation, remediation, and compliance projects from proposal through closure.
Develop project scopes, schedules, budgets, work plans, and health and safety plans.
Lead multidisciplinary teams of geologists, engineers, hydrogeologists, risk assessors, and environmental scientists.
Monitor project financial performance, including revenue, profitability, utilization, and forecasting.
Coordinate subcontractors, laboratories, drilling contractors, and remediation vendors.
Maintain quality assurance and quality control standards.

Technical Leadership

Serve as a technical lead for sites impacted by a range of chemical and petroleum-related contaminants in soil, groundwater, sediment, soil vapor, surface water, and other environmental media.
Design and oversee:
Site investigations and environmental assessments
Soil and groundwater characterization
Soil vapor and vapor intrusion assessments
Human health and ecological risk assessments
Remedial investigations/feasibility studies (RI/FS)
Corrective action and site closure programs

Evaluate and implement appropriate remediation approaches and technologies based on site conditions, regulatory requirements, and project objectives.
Interpret environmental data, evaluate remedial alternatives, and develop practical recommendations for investigation, remediation, and long-term site management.

Client Relationship Management

Act as primary client contact for key accounts.
Support strategic planning with industrial, manufacturing, petroleum, commercial, and government clients.
Prepare and present technical findings to clients, regulators, and stakeholders.
Maintain long-term client relationships while identifying opportunities for additional services.

Business Development

Lead proposal preparation and pricing.
Support capture planning and opportunity pursuit.
Identify new clients and expand existing accounts.
Participate in industry organizations and conferences.

Regulatory Expertise

Demonstrated Experience Working With

EPA CERCLA/Superfund programs
RCRA Corrective Action
State cleanup and voluntary remediation programs
Vapor intrusion guidance
UST and industrial facility closure programs
Applicable federal, state, and local environmental regulations

Qualifications

BS in Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Geological Engineering, Hydrogeology, Geology, or related field.
12+ years of environmental consulting experience.
7+ years managing complex environmental investigation and remediation projects.
Demonstrated success managing projects exceeding $500K to $5M+ annually.
Significant experience with environmental investigation, remediation, and regulatory compliance involving contaminated soil, groundwater, and other environmental media.
Professional certifications such as PE, PG, CHG, PMP, REM, or CHMM preferred.

Why You'll Love Working For Us

Company-subsidized medical and dental.
Company-paid life, short, and long-term disability.
401k match, tuition assistance, and more.
Cross-training and the ability to work on a variety of projects.
Performance-based bonuses or other incentives.
Working with the best and brightest in the industry.
2,000+ employee national firm with 70+ locations across the US.

jobs.title: Computational Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
About the Company

About AlignedAt Aligned, we partner with the world's leading AI labs to push the frontier of AI knowledge in fields like STEM, medicine, finance, and the humanities. Our platform matches subject-matter experts (like you) with paid consulting work on frontier projects at these labs.

About the Role

We are looking to expand our team of expert consultants with 12 PhD Environmental Scientists for part-time, fully-remote work supporting frontier AI research. This role includes stress-testing leading AI models on research-level environmental science problems, creating and verifying complex questions and explanations in your area of expertise, and assessing whether AI-generated reasoning meets the standards of a trained environmental scientist.

Responsibilities

Stress-testing leading AI models on research-level environmental science problems
Creating complex questions and explanations in your area of expertise
Verifying complex questions and explanations in your area of expertise
Assessing whether AI-generated reasoning meets the standards of a trained environmental scientist

Qualifications

You hold a PhD in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, or a closely related field, and you are actively engaged in computational research.

Required Skills

Fluent English reading and writing skills
PhD in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, or a closely related field
Hands-on experience in computational modeling, simulation, or large-scale data analysis
You build or apply quantitative models and work with large environmental datasets.

Preferred Skills

Faculty, postdoctoral researchers, and research scientists in university environmental science, environmental engineering, or earth and environmental systems departments
Scientists at government agencies such as the EPA, USGS, or equivalent national environmental and water agencies
Researchers at national laboratories or research institutes working on environmental modeling and simulation
Industry scientists in environmental consulting, water resources, energy, or corporate sustainability and risk analytics

Pay range and compensation package

Projects start at $60-80 USD per hour, with top-performing experts on our platform earning $150+ USD / hour.
